{{short description|Brazilian biologist (born 1975)}}

'''Dario Simões Zamboni''' (born 29 December 1975 in [[Jaboticabal]]) is a Brazilian [[biologist]] whose research concerns [[Medical microbiology|microbial pathogenesis]], [[innate immunity]], and [[infectious disease]]s. Currently, he is a professor at the [[Universidade de São Paulo|University of São Paulo]].<ref name="ABC">[https://www.abc.org.br/membro/dario-simoes-zamboni/ Brazilian Academy of Sciences]</ref><ref>Reinaldo José Lopes. "[http://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ciencia/2014/05/1459933-lista-global-de-cientistas-em-evidencia-antes-dos-40-destaca-biologo-brasileiro.shtml Lista global de cientistas em evidência antes dos 40 destaca biólogo brasileiro]", ''[[Folha de S.Paulo]]'', 2014</ref>

He is a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="ABC" />
